chunks: And remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu al-Kifl. Every one of them is among the best.

key_terms.وَالْيَسَعَ: Elisha (Al-Yasa'), a prophet mentioned in the Quran
key_terms.وَذَا الْكِفْلِ: Dhu al-Kifl, a prophet known for his constancy

ai.seo_question: Who are Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu al-Kifl in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the collective excellence of these prophets, with Dhu al-Kifl often identified as either Elisha or Job, emphasizing their steadfastness in divine duty. The term 'al-Akhyar' (the choicest) underscores their moral purity and role as intercessors, a concept central to Shia theology regarding the hierarchy of prophets and imams. This affirmation serves to validate their spiritual authority and continuity in the chain of divine guidance.
